explainer_content.short_definition: Gospel-fired southern R&B with grit, horns, and studio-band heat.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Southern soul took shape through Memphis and Muscle Shoals studios where church-trained voices met hard-working rhythm sections and horn arrangements.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It gave soul music a rawer counterweight to Motown polish and shaped rock, funk, and modern R&B vocal ideals.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The records feel live, sweaty, and vocally urgent even when the writing is tightly crafted.
